title: verify-ios-change evidence manifest, schema 6
description: Evidence for one verification run, valid while unfinished and when completed. Update it in place as work progresses; use null for unknown values. scripts/validate-manifest also checks references and evidence; --final checks completion and the generated report.

id.description: Run ID, the run directory name.

project_dir.description: Absolute path of the project under verification.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC start time, for example 2026-10-12T06:30:00Z.

action_driver.description: ID of the one tool whose roles include action_driver; null until one is selected.

effort.description: Resolved active host effort; null when unavailable or unrecognized. Advanced recovery requires high, xhigh or max.

environment.description: Build and device identity. Record readiness evidence in the app/build check.

test_cases.description: The authoritative current plan, updated in place. Empty when the run is blocked before planning.

revisions.description: One record per plan divergence or advanced attempt. Ordinary and advanced revisions use evidence-driven stopping.

checks.description: Readiness, navigation and cleanup checks, one record per capability, updated in place to the latest result.

artifacts.description: Evidence files, each registered once and referenced by ID.

limitations.description: Evidence that could not be collected, and the cases it affects.

side_observations.description: Findings outside the change under verification.

temporary_modifications.description: Temporary diagnostic edits and advanced source/runtime interventions, with evidence and cleanup recorded independently of results.

id.description: Unique within its collection, for example TC1, rev.1, chk.build, tool.driver, a.1.

rationale.description: Why this case follows from the change.

sources.description: Requirement sources (PRD, design reference, diff) as strings.

preconditions.description: Required starting state, each with the in-session reset that restores it.

status.description: planned until judged. pass and assisted_pass need every step observed and a screenshot; assisted_pass also needs a linked intervention preserving the target behaviour.

detail.description: Explains assisted_pass scope and limits, or a fail, inconclusive or withdrawn result; null otherwise.

artifacts.description: IDs of evidence for the case as a whole.

observed.description: Locator, observation method and result; null until the step is exercised.

phase.description: ordinary recovery uses evidence-driven stopping; advanced recovery requires the effort gate and an exhausted ordinary approach.

summary.description: What triggered the divergence and what changed. For advanced recovery, explain ordinary exhaustion, the new hypothesis and what the attempt learned.

impact.description: blocker: remaining unavailable after recovery and prevents verification; limitation: optional evidence unavailable; null otherwise. A blocker or limitation needs status fail or inconclusive.

detail.description: Explains an unavailable capability; required when impact is set.

roles.description: Build tooling and inspectors can be distinct from the action driver.

kind.description: Use native_dump for print-tree captures. Video and gif capture are optional.

path.description: File path relative to the run directory, without .. segments.

description.description: The edit or runtime intervention and why it was needed; include its mechanism and affected source/state.

purpose.description: diagnostic is ordinary behaviour-neutral observation; intervention is an advanced recovery technique, including added instrumentation needed for that recovery.

scope.description: For an intervention, identify the real behaviour preserved and the conditions or claims left unproven. Null for ordinary diagnostics.

state.description: Source restoration only: reverted, not_reverted, or runtime_only when no source was edited. Independent of case results; no recheck is required.

runtime_state.description: Build/process identity used for evidence and the runtime state left for inspection. Required at Finish; null while not yet observed.

restoration.description: Concrete steps to restore retained build/state/resources, or an explanation that no further restoration is needed. Required at Finish; null while being determined.

test_cases.description: All cases affected by this modification, retained even after later independent verification. An intervention requires at least one affected case.

result_cases.description: Subset of test_cases whose current verification depends on this modification. Remove a case only after independent evidence replaces that dependency; preserve test_cases and artifacts as history.

artifacts.description: Patch, fixture, debugger transcript or other evidence of the modification. Required for a completed assisted_pass.
